newsitem.title: USA: L.A. school athlete dies in freak accident.
newsitem.headline: L.A. school athlete dies in freak accident.

text.p: A high school athlete has died from head injuries after bouncing off a pole vault pad and landing on his head, Los Angeles police said on Wednesday.

Heath Taylor, 17, a member of the William S. Hart High School track and field team, died at a local hospital on Tuesday night about three hours after the accident, Los Angeles County Sheriff's Deputy Angie Prewett said.
"As Heath landed in the pole vault pit he bounced off the padding and struck the ground head first, suffering severe head trauma," Prewett said.
Last Wednesday, Craig Kelford, 16, of Peninsula High School, died after being struck in the back of the head by a discus thrown by another athlete.
